title: PathoSage：基于经验感知的病理学多源证据裁决智能工作流
summary: PathoSage是一个三阶段框架，通过结构化证据审议和Beta-Bernoulli经验系统，独立评估工具证据、进行冲突分析并生成最终判断，有效缓解病理学多模态大模型的幻觉和分类器分歧问题。
summary_en: PathoSage is a three-stage framework that uses structured evidence deliberation and a Beta-Bernoulli experience system to independently evaluate tool evidence, perform conflict analysis, and generate final judgments, effectively mitigating hallucinations and classifier disagreements in pathology MLLMs.
